newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bonds generally underperform on day.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bonds generally underperform on day.

text.p: Australian bonds gave up, or pared, their initial spread tightening against other dollar bloc bonds on Friday after the local market succumbed to a late bout of pre-weekend profit-taking.
Traders said local turnover was relatively light given that that long-dated yields had touched new 2-1/2 year lows shortly after the opening.
The market managed to outperform Canadian debt on the day, however, due to supply concerns there.

Meanwhile, the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread continued to widen, after touching its lowest level in over two years at 104 basis points earlier in the week, which analysts saw was due to a lack of key local data here.
New Zealand bonds reduced their premium over Australia after the N.Z. June quarter GDP rose just 0.3 percent, its lowest quarterly rise since September 1992.
